clue.text: Nursery building with water pipe you installed

indicators.note: installed means fitted inside, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: a hose is a flexible pipe for water
thou is the archaic form of you

explanation.surface: A plumber fits a water pipe into a plant nursery building.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated glasshouse where young plants are raised is a nursery building for gardeners.

clue.text: Priam's wife finds explosive on island

parts.note: HE is the abbreviation for high explosive
Cuba is a Caribbean island

explanation.surface: A Trojan queen comes across a bomb on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend the queen of Troy married to King Priam is named Hecuba.

clue.text: An earful from one in shop keeping

indicators.note: keeping means holding within, so the shop word surrounds the one

parts.note: trade, as in 'in the shop trade', means retail business
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper gets a scolding from someone who works in the store.
explanation.definitionFit: A long angry speech is the kind of scolding colloquially called an earful.

clue.text: Being indebted for nothing, go with speed

parts.note: O is the round zero, nothing
to wing it is to fly along swiftly

explanation.surface: Someone in debt for nothing rushes off at speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Money still due is outstanding, so a debtor is in arrears.

clue.text: State involved in cunning scheme for terribly hard work

indicators.note: involved in means wrapped up inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: sly means cunning
to aver is to state firmly

explanation.surface: A state is caught up in a crafty plan to make people toil terribly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like a noun for a nation but is a verb, to declare. 'scheme for' only links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Forced, unpaid toil under bondage is the byword for exhausting labour.

clue.text: Expression of disgust on street before a holiday

parts.note: fie is an old exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: Someone says 'yuck' about the street ahead of a holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish festival day is a public celebration, a holiday.

clue.text: Idle aunts abandoned, kept safely isolated

indicators.note: abandoned suggests wild, unrestrained, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Lazy aunts left alone were kept safe and cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: Protected by a barrier against heat, sound or current means shielded and cut off.

clue.text: Dog eating a duck — and a marine mammal!

indicators.note: eating means swallowing, so the dog word surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: a setter is a breed of gun dog
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A dog gobbles up a duck, and a sea creature too!
explanation.definitionFit: This furry kelp-dwelling animal of the Pacific is a sea-living mammal.

clue.text: A contemptible person — he turned up in this pub

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the turned word goes within the contemptible person

parts.note: a louse is a contemptible person

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the word he is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A despicable man appeared in this pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reads the word he from bottom to top, since this is a down clue; the result sits inside the insect word.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a tavern serving beer, it names the pub in the scene.

clue.text: Character at home with a novice could be Roman priest

parts.note: a card is an eccentric character
in means at home
L is the learner plate, a novice

explanation.surface: An eccentric at home with a beginner might be a Catholic churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior cleric of the Church of Rome, one who elects the Pope.

clue.text: Property in car

explanation.surface: Something owned inside a car.
explanation.definitionFit: Land owned by someone is landed property; a large family car with a rear door is also called this, the British word for a station wagon.

clue.text: American edition is second-hand

explanation.surface: An American edition of a book is not new.
explanation.definitionFit: Previously owned goods are described as worn or pre-owned.

clue.text: Gradually become involved in corrupt university practice, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear means the phrase is judged by how it is spoken

parts.note: paying money for qualifications is to buy degrees

explanation.surface: Slowly getting caught up in a crooked academic racket, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become involved in' is linking surface. Buying degrees sounds the same as the phrase meaning step by step.
explanation.definitionFit: Step by step, little by little, is the sense of the idiom.

clue.text: Game learner, man from Germany maybe

parts.note: L is the learner plate
Otto is a typical German man's name

explanation.surface: A game played by a beginner and a German fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A number-drawing game of chance like bingo.

clue.text: Loud chap in brawl

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
Ray is a man's name, a chap

explanation.surface: A noisy fellow joins in a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy fight or scuffle is a brawl.

clue.text: Prominent feature of Italian portraits?

parts.note: a face's jutting part as seen in pictures of ancient citizens of Rome

explanation.surface: Something that stands out in Italian painted portraits.
explanation.definitionFit: A high-bridged, aquiline nose is named after the profiles on ancient Roman busts.

clue.text: Little girl facing the three basic school subjects trembles

parts.note: Di is short for Diana, a girl's name
the three Rs are reading, writing and arithmetic

explanation.surface: A young girl faces reading, writing and arithmetic and shakes.
explanation.definitionFit: To dither is to hesitate nervously, to waver or quiver.

clue.text: Seamen in capsized vessels showing bottle

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the seamen go within the vessels
capsized in a down clue means the word for vessels is turned upside down

parts.note: pots are vessels
a crew is a ship's seamen

explanation.surface: Sailors in upturned boats demonstrate courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capsized' turns the vessels word upside down in this down clue, giving STOP. 'bottle' looks like slang for courage, but it means a bottle with a twist-off cap.
explanation.definitionFit: A container closed by a threaded cap is a bottle of that type.

clue.text: Lady in restaurant with excellent hair

parts.note: A1 means excellent, written here as AI
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A woman dining out has superb hair.
explanation.definitionFit: The woman who serves tables in an eatery is a server.

clue.text: Delighted little child dangerously equipped!

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for child
carrying weapons is to be armed

explanation.surface: A thrilled toddler is carrying a weapon!
explanation.definitionFit: Charmed means enchanted, pleased greatly.

clue.text: County's reverse of fortune

explanation.surface: A county suffers a setback in its luck.
explanation.definitionFit: Down is a county of Northern Ireland; a down, as in ups and downs, is a setback in one's luck.

clue.text: From what they say, the girl produced

indicators.note: from what they say means the word is judged by its spoken sound

parts.note: a maid is a girl

explanation.surface: Gossip says the girl created it.
explanation.definitionFit: Made means created or manufactured.

clue.text: French author gets longer story included

indicators.note: included means taken inside, so the story goes within the longer word

parts.note: more means further, longer
a lie is a story, a falsehood

explanation.surface: A French writer gets a longer tale accepted.
explanation.definitionFit: The 17th-century comic playwright of Tartuffe was a French writer.

clue.text: A gentle ring of bells to attract one's enjoyment

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for soft
a peal is a ring of bells

explanation.surface: A soft chime of church bells draws people's pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: To be attractive or interesting to someone is to win their liking.

clue.text: Old car Rex put beneath a hole in the ground

indicators.note: put beneath in a down clue means the king is placed below the old car

parts.note: a crate is slang for an old car
R is the abbreviation of Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: An old banger and a king are placed under a pit.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowl-shaped cavity, as made by a meteor or bomb, is a pit.

clue.text: John turned to Len

indicators.note: turned means twisted round, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: John faced Len.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Elton John is the famous singer, so John's first name pairs with it.

clue.text: Rolls brought into the dining-room say?

definitions.text: Rolls brought into the dining-room say?

parts.words: Rolls brought into the dining-room say?
parts.note: not bread rolls served at dinner but decorating rolls hung on the room's walls

explanation.surface: Bread rolls served at the dinner table.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative paper covering for walls comes in rolls taken into a room to be hung.

clue.text: South American river in book illustration

explanation.surface: A river in South America within a book picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The River Plate is the estuary between Argentina and Uruguay; a full-page picture in a book is also called this.

clue.text: Thrill stemmed by quiet remorse

indicators.note: stemmed by means held in by the following words, which hide the letters

explanation.surface: Excitement is checked by silent regret.
explanation.definitionFit: A quiver or shiver of excitement is a thrill.

clue.text: After ten years national organisation becomes degenerate

indicators.note: after means the organisation follows the ten years

parts.note: a decade is ten years
NT is the National Trust, the British heritage organisation

explanation.surface: After a decade, a national body goes downhill.
explanation.definitionFit: Morally declined and self-indulgent means degenerate.

clue.text: Father's boy? 25 must be!

parts.note: Pa's means father's
Ted is a boy's name

explanation.surface: Is this Dad's son? Clue 25 must be!
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is WALLPAPER, which must be glued to hang.
explanation.definitionFit: Wall coverings have to be glued, stuck with adhesive, before hanging.

clue.text: One making merry when left ousts right — a radical dissenter

indicators.note: left pushing out right means the letter L takes the place of R

parts.note: a reveller is someone making merry

explanation.surface: A partygoer swings from right to left and becomes a radical rebel.
explanation.walkthrough: The Levellers were a radical group in the English Civil War demanding equal rights.
explanation.definitionFit: The Levellers were 17th-century English radicals seeking equality, so one is a radical rebel.
